question: Which of the following states has the highest population density in India as per Census 2011?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Bihar has a total density of** 1106**.
 
• In the 2001 Census, the density of Bihar was** 881**.
 
• The total population of Bihar is** 104099452**.
